# Dependencies

Generated by `scripts/deps.py` from the facts `scripts/Audit.lean --deps` writes; the gate
regenerates every file and fails if one differs (CONTRIBUTING.md). Do not edit by hand. The graphs
are `docs/deps/{packages,modules,claims}.dot`, rendered to `.svg` and `.pdf` with graphviz `dot`.

## Claims

The claims are the theorems among the audit targets (`scripts/targets.txt`). Each claim is
walked by `closure` (scripts/Audit.lean): the constants its statement and proof mention,
then those of every declaration of ours they reach (type and body), stopping at the first
external constant. Ours: the declarations of `GPUProof/` and `MojoProof/` reached,
auto-generated ones (matchers, equation lemmas, constructors, projections) not listed.
External: the external constants reached, by package. Axioms: every axiom reached through the
whole environment. TRUST: the ids of docs/TRUST.md whose anchor in `scripts/trust.tsv` the walk
reaches. The complete lists are in `docs/deps/claims.tsv` (claim, kind, module or package,
name).

TRUST anchors (`scripts/trust.tsv`): T1 all; T2 module `MojoProof.Kernels`; T3 module `MojoProof.Kernels`; T4 module `MojoProof.LLVM.Lexer`; T4 module `MojoProof.LLVM.Printer`; T4 module `MojoProof.LLVM.Quote`; T4 module `MojoProof.Kernels`; T5 module `MojoProof.LLVM.Intrinsic`; T6 module `MojoProof.Util.SHA256`; T6 module `MojoProof.Kernels`; T7 modules `MojoProof.Sem`; T8 const `MojoProof.Sem.Layout.align`; T9 const `MojoProof.Sem.contract`; T10 const `MojoProof.Sem.rsqrtOk`; T11 const `MojoProof.Sem.Mem.alloc`; T12 const `MojoProof.Sem.withAttrs`; T12 const `MojoProof.LLVM.Func.check`; T12 const `MojoProof.Sem.Grid.Kept`; T13 const `MojoProof.Sem.Grid.Step`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.AccOk`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.AccBy`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.fragA`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.fragB`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.fragC`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.ldm`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.quadA`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.quadB`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.quadC`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.gridAcc`; T14 const `MojoProof.Sem.mmaGrid`; T15 const `MojoProof.Sem.Async.Step`; T16 module `GPUProof.Layout.Basic`; T16 module `GPUProof.Layout.Algebra`; T16 module `GPUProof.Layout.Bits`; T16 module `GPUProof.Layout.Crd`; T16 module `GPUProof.Layout.TwoLevel`; T17 const `MojoProof.Float.Ex2Close`; T18 const `MojoProof.Import.torchLean`.
